title: How to Cancel ChatGPT Plus — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel your ChatGPT Plus subscription in 60 seconds. Keep access until the end of your billing cycle. Here's exactly where to click.
intro: Canceling ChatGPT Plus is quick and painless — no retention calls, no dark patterns. OpenAI lets you cancel with 3 clicks and you keep access through the end of your paid period.

steps.title: Open ChatGPT Settings
steps.text: Go to chat.openai.com and click your profile icon in the bottom-left corner. Select "Settings" from the menu. Alternatively, navigate directly to chat.openai.com/settings/subscription.

steps.title: Click "Manage my subscription"
steps.text: In the Settings panel, find the "Subscription" section and click "Manage my subscription". This opens the billing portal.
steps.tip: If you subscribed through the iOS app, you'll see a note directing you to Apple's subscription settings instead.

steps.title: Click "Cancel plan"
steps.text: In the billing portal, click "Cancel plan" or "Cancel subscription". You may be shown a comparison of Plus vs Free features.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Click "Cancel subscription" on the confirmation dialog. You'll receive an email confirmation. Your Plus access continues until the end of your current billing cycle.
steps.tip: Note your billing date — you can keep using GPT-4, DALL-E, and other Plus features until that date.

warnings: If you subscribed via Apple App Store (iOS app), you MUST cancel through Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions on your device. Canceling in ChatGPT settings won't stop Apple billing.
After cancellation, you lose access to GPT-4, DALL-E 3, Advanced Data Analysis, custom GPTs, and priority access during peak times.
Your chat history is preserved on the free plan — you won't lose past conversations.
If you have a ChatGPT Team or Enterprise plan, only the workspace admin can cancel.

faqs.q: Will I lose my chat history if I cancel ChatGPT Plus?
faqs.a: No. All your conversations, custom GPTs, and settings are preserved. You simply lose access to Plus-only features like GPT-4 and DALL-E.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund for ChatGPT Plus?
faqs.a: OpenAI doesn't offer automatic refunds, but you can request one by contacting help.openai.com within a few days of being charged. They've been known to issue credits for unused portions.

faqs.q: What's the difference between ChatGPT Free and Plus?
faqs.a: Free gives you access to GPT-3.5 with usage limits. Plus ($20/mo) gives GPT-4, DALL-E 3, web browsing, code interpreter, custom GPTs, and priority access.

faqs.q: How do I cancel ChatGPT if I subscribed through Apple?
faqs.a: On iPhone: Settings → tap your name → Subscriptions → ChatGPT → Cancel. On Mac: App Store → Account → Subscriptions → ChatGPT → Cancel.

refund.details: OpenAI doesn't advertise refunds, but if you contact support at help.openai.com within a few days of a charge you didn't intend (e.g., forgot to cancel before renewal), they often issue a one-time courtesy refund.

retentionTactics: OpenAI may show a feature comparison reminding you what you'll lose (GPT-4, DALL-E, etc.).
They don't use aggressive retention tactics — cancellation is straightforward.
